notes:
Original primary source unavailable: DOI landing page returned 403; OpenAlex no OA location; primary-paper search did not locate a free full original source. Secondary quotations in replication reports not used for original statistic fields. Replication extraction is independent. The table statistic F(1,34)=24.61 is the lexicality main effect, not the repetition-blindness condition effect; the narrative verdict describes failure of RB and must not be inferred from this significant lexicality test.
Source follow-up: Fresh original-only validation from the supplied published-article text; title, authors, year and DOI match the assigned reference. Study 6 and the neutral repetition-blindness/nonword description identify the nonword critical-pair recall contrast. No finer original locator was supplied. Requested OR is not printed for this test; effect-size value and metric remain null, with the printed participant-level F statistic retained in test_statistic. The accompanying item-level result is F2(1, 46) ⫽ 9.69, p < .005; it is a separate analysis, not the participant sample. No conversion was performed. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders; no replication source was inspected.
